stream with fresh inputs. Each instance is a separate conversation: the next one
starts without this one's messages.

Grids are lists of rows; cells are integers 0-9; dimensions are 1-30.

Each demo request returns one more input-output pair of the task, up to the demo cap shown
with the input.

each demo request. An instance is over when a submission is correct or when the attempt
cap is reached, and one that ends unsolved costs the whole budget, 16, however
many submissions and demo requests it used. Feedback on a submission is only
correct/incorrect. There is no way to abandon an instance, and finish is refused until
the instance is over. Each instance is scored on its own, and lower cost is better.

def solve(inp):
    H,W=len(inp),len(inp[0])

    best=None

        r0,r1,c0,c1=min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs)
        h_=r1-r0+1; w_=c1-c0+1
        area=h_*w_-sum(1 for r in range(r0,r1+1) for c in range(c0,c1+1) if inp[r][c]!=v)
        if best is None or area>best[0]:

    inner_h=r1-r0-1; inner_w=c1-c0-1
    out=[[fv]*(inner_w+2) for _ in range(inner_h+2)]
    out[0]=[fv]*W if False else None
    for i in range(inner_h+2):
        for j in range(inner_w+2): out[i][j]=fv
    # fill 0 inside, replace with seeds via block mapping
    out[1:-1][0][0] if False else out
    # hmm redo: simpler: start blank with border fv, interior all 0
    out=[[fv]*(inner_w+2) for _ in range(inner_h+2)]
    for i in range(inner_h+2):
        for j in range(inner_w+2): out[i][j]=fv
    for i in range(1,inner_h+1):
        for j in range(1,inner_w+1): out[i][j]=0
    # seed cluster: non-bg, non-frame-color pixels outside the frame
    seed=[(r,c,inp[r][c]) for r in range(H) for c in range(W)
          if inp[r][c]!=bg and inp[r][c]!=fv and not (r0<=r<=r1 and c0<=c<=c1)]
    srows=sorted(set(p[0] for p in seed)); scols=sorted(set(p[1] for p in seed))
    s0,s1,s0c,s1c=min(srows),max(srows),min(scols),max(scols)

import os,re,json
from collections import Counter
d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
    k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
    rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
    if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
        G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]

def solve(inp):
    H,W=len(inp),len(inp[0])
    cnt=Counter(v for row in inp for v in row)
    bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    best=None
    for v in cnt:
        if v==bg or cnt[v]<8: continue
        pts=[(r,c) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if inp[r][c]==v]
        rs=[p[0] for p in pts]; cs=[p[1] for p in pts]
        r0,r1,c0,c1=min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs)
        h_=r1-r0+1; w_=c1-c0+1
        if best is None or (h_*w_)>best[0]:
            best=(h_*w_,v,(r0,r1,c0,c1))
    _,fv,(r0,r1,c0,c1)=best
    ih=r1-r0-1; iw=c1-c0-1
    out=[[fv]*(iw+2) for _ in range(ih+2)]
    for i in range(1,ih+1):
        for j in range(1,iw+1): out[i][j]=0
    seed=[(r,c,inp[r][c]) for r in range(H) for c in range(W)
          if inp[r][c]!=bg and inp[r][c]!=fv and not (r0<=r<=r1 and c0<=c1)]
    srows=sorted(set(p[0] for p in seed)); scols=sorted(set(p[1] for p in seed))
    sh=srows[-1]-srows[0]+1; sw=scols[-1]-scols[0]+1
    bh=ih//sh; bw=iw//sw
    for (r,c,v) in seed:
        bi=(r-srows[0])*bh//sh; bj=(c-scols[0])*bw//sw
        for rr in range(bi*bh,(bi+1)*bh):
            for cc in range(bj*bw,(bj+1)*bw):
                out[1+rr][1+cc]=v
    return out

import os,re,json
from collections import Counter
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load(); print(sorted(G))

def solve(inp,verbose=False):
    H,W=len(inp),len(inp[0])
    cnt=Counter(v for row in inp for v in row)
    bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    best=None
    for v in cnt:
        if v==bg: continue
        pts=[(r,c) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if inp[r][c]==v]
        rs=[p[0] for p in pts]; cs=[p[1] for p in pts]
        r0,r1,c0,c1=min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs)
        h_=r1-r0+1; w_=c1-c0+1
        if h_>=3 and w_>=3 and len(pts)==2*(h_+w_)-4:
            if best is None or (h_*w_) > best[0]:
                best=(h_*w_, v, (r0,r1,c0,c1))
    _,fv,(r0,r1,c0,c1)=best
    ih=r1-r0-1; iw=c1-c0-1
    out=[[fv]*(iw+2) for _ in range(ih+2)]
    seed=[(r,c,inp[r][c]) for r in range(H) for c in range(W)
          if inp[r][c]!=bg and inp[r][c]!=fv and not (r0<=r<=r1 and c0<=c1)]
    srows=sorted(set(p[0] for p in seed)); scols=sorted(set(p[1] for p in seed))
    sh=srows[-1]-srows[0]+1; sw=scols[-1]-scols[0]+1
    bh=ih//sh; bw=iw//sw
    if verbose: print('seed:',seed,'sh,sw',sh,sw,'bh,bw',bh,bw)
    for (r,c,v) in seed:
        bi=(r-srows[0])*bh//sh; bj=(c-scols[0])*bw//sw
        for rr in range(bi*bh,min((bi+1)*bh,ih+1)):
            for cc in range(bj*bw,min((bj+1)*bw,iw+1)):
                out[1+rr][1+cc]=v
    return out

from collections import Counter
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):

    return G
G=load(); print(sorted(G))

def solve(inp):
    H,W=len(inp),len(inp[0])
    cnt=Counter(v for row in inp for v in row)
    bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    best=None
    for v in set(v for row in inp for v in row):
        if v==bg: continue
        pts=[(r,c) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if inp[r][c]==v]
        rs=[p[0] for p in pts]; cs=[p[1] for p in pts]
        r0,r1,c0,c1=min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs)
        h_=r1-r0+1; w_=c1-c0+1
        perim={(r,c) for r in range(r0,r1+1) for c in range(c0,c1+1) if r in(r0,r1) or c in(c0,c1)}

    out=[[0]*(iw+2) for _ in range(ih+2)]
    seed=[(r,c,inp[r][c]) for r in range(H) for c in range(W)
          if not (r0<=r<=r1 and c0<=c1)]
    srows=sorted(set(p[0] for p in seed)); scols=sorted(set(p[1] for p in seed))
    sh=srows[-1]-srows[0]+1; sw=scols[-1]-scols[0]+1
    bh=ih//sh; bw=iw//sw
    for (r,c,v) in seed:
        bi=(r-srows[0])*bh//sh; bj=(c-scols[0])*bw//sw
        for rr in range(bi*bh,min((bi+1)*bh,ih)):
            for cc in range(bj*bw,min((bj+1)*bw,iw)):
                out[1+rr][1+cc]=v
    # draw frame border
    for j in range(iw+2): out[0][j]=fv; out[ih+1][j]=fv
    for i in range(ih+2): out[i][0]=fv; out[i][iw+1]=fv
    return out

import os,re,json
from collections import Counter
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()

def solve(inp):
    H,W=len(inp),len(inp[0])
    cnt=Counter(v for row in inp for v in row)
    bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    best=None
    for v in set(v for row in inp for v in row):
        if v==bg: continue
        pts=[(r,c) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if inp[r][c]==v]
        rs=[p[0] for p in pts]; cs=[p[1] for p in pts]
        r0,r1,c0,c1=min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs)
        hh=r1-r0+1; ww=c1-c0+1
        perim={(r,c) for r in range(r0,r1+1) for c in range(c0,c1+1) if r in(r0,r1) or c in(c0,c1)}
        if len(pts)==len(perim) and hh>=3 and ww>=3:
            if best is None or hh*ww>best[0]:
                best=(hh*ww,v,(r0,r1,c0,c1))
    _,fv,(r0,r1,c0,c1)=best
    ih=r1-r0-1; iw=c1-c0-1
    out=[[fv]*(iw+2) for _ in range(ih+2)]
    # seed cells: any pixel outside the frame rect bbox, plus pixels in the rect interior that aren't fv
    seed=[(r,c,inp[r][c]) for r in range(H) for c in range(W)
          if not (r0<=r<=r1 and c0<=c<=c1) or (r0<r<r1 and c0<c<c1)]
    srows=sorted(set(p[0] for p in seed)); scols=sorted(set(p[1] for p in seed))
    sh=srows[-1]-srows[0]+1; sw=scols[-1]-scols[0]+1
    bh=ih//sh; bw=iw//sw
    for (r,c,v) in seed:
        bi=(r-srows[0])*bh//sh; bj=(c-scols[0])*bw//sw
        for rr in range(bi*bh,min((bi+1)*bh,ih)):
            for cc in range(bj*bw,min((bj+1)*bw,iw)):
                out[1+rr][1+bw] if False else out[1+rr][1+cc]=v
    return out

def solve(inp):
    H,W=len(inp),len(inp[0])
    cnt=Counter(v for row in inp for v in row)
    bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    best=None
    for v in set(v for row in inp for v in row):
        if v==bg: continue
        pts=[(r,c) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if inp[r][c]==v]
        rs=[p[0] for p in pts]; cs=[p[1] for p in pts]
        r0,r1,c0,c1=min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs)
        hh=r1-r0+1; ww=c1-c0+1
        perim={(a,b) for a in range(r0,r1+1) for b in range(c0,c1+1) if a in(r0,r1) or b in(c0,c1)}
        if len(pts)==len(perim) and hh>=3 and ww>=3:
            if best is None or hh*ww>best[0]:
                best=(hh*ww,v,(r0,r1,c0,c1))
    _,fv,(r0,r1,c0,c1)=best
    ih=r1-r0-1; iw=c1-c0-1
    out=[[bg]*(iw+2) for _ in range(ih+2)]
    for j in range(iw+2): out[0][j]=fv; out[ih+1][j]=fv
    for i in range(ih+2): out[i][0]=fv; out[i][iw+1]=fv
    # seed: pixels with color != fg and != frame color
    seed=[(r,c,inp[r][c]) for r in range(H) for c in range(W)
          if inp[r][c]!=bg and inp[r][c]!=fv]
    srows=sorted(set(p[0] for p in seed)); scols=sorted(set(p[1] for p in seed))
    sh=srows[-1]-srows[0]+1; sw=scols[-1]-scols[0]+1
    bh=ih//sh; bw=iw//sw
    for (r,c,v) in seed:
        bi=(r-srows[0])*bh//sh; bj=(c-scols[0])*bw//sw
        for rr in range(bi*bh,min((bi+1)*bh,ih)):
            for cc in range(bj*bw,min((bj+1)*bw,iw)):
                out[1+rr][1+cc]=v
    return out

def solve(inp):
    H,W=len(inp),len(inp[0])
    cnt=Counter(x for row in inp for x in row)
    bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    best=None
    for v in set(x for row in inp for x in row):
        if v==bg: continue
        pts=[(r,c) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if inp[r][c]==v]
        rs=[p[0] for p in pts]; cs=[p[1] for p in pts]
        r0,r1,c0,c1=min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs)
        hh=r1-r0+1; ww=c1-c0+1
        perim={(a,b) for a in range(r0,r1+1) for b in range(c0,c1+1) if a in(r0,r1) or b in(c0,c1)}
        if len(pts)==len(perim) and hh>=3 and ww>=3:
            if best is None or hh*ww>best[0]: best=(hh*ww,v,(r0,r1,c0,c1))
    _,fv,(r0,r1,c0,c1)=best
    ih,iw=r1-r0-1,c1-c0-1
    out=[[fv]*(iw+2) for _ in range(ih+2)]
    # seed: all pixels outside the frame bbox
    seeds=[(r,c,inp[r][c]) for r in range(H) for c in range(W)
           if not(r0<=r<=r1 and c0<=c<=c1)]
    srows=sorted(set(p[0] for p in seeds)); scols=sorted(set(p[1] for p in seeds))
    sh=srows[-1]-srows[0]+1; sw=scols[-1]-scols[0]+1
    bh=ih//sh; bw=iw//sw
    for (r,c,v) in seeds:
        bi=(r-srows[0])*bh//sh; bj=(c-scols[0])*bw//sw
        for rr in range(bi*bh,min((bi+1)*bh,ih)):
            for cc in range(bj*bw,min((bj+1)*bw,iw)):
                out[1+rr][1+cc]=v
    return out
print('demo ok:',[solve(G[f'Demo pair {k} input'])==G[f'Demo pair {k} output'] for k in (1,2,3)])

def solve(inp):
    H,W=len(inp),len(inp[0])
    cnt=Counter(x for row in inp for x in row)
    bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    best=None
    for v in set(x for row in inp for x in row):
        if v==bg: continue
        pts=[(r,c) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if inp[r][c]==v]
        rs=[p[0] for p in pts]; cs=[p[1] for p in pts]
        r0,r1,c0,c1=min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs)
        hh=r1-r0+1; ww=c1-c0+1
        perim={(a,b) for a in range(r0,r1+1) for b in range(c0,c1+1) if a in(r0,r1) or b in(c0,c1)}
        if len(pts)==len(perim) and hh>=3 and ww>=3:
            if best is None or hh*ww>best[0]: best=(hh*ww,v,(r0,r1,c0,c1))
    _,fv,(r0,r1,c0,c1)=best
    ih,iw=r1-r0-1,c1-c0-1
    out=[[fv]*(iw+2) for _ in range(ih+2)]
    # seed = all non-bg pixels outside the frame bbox
    seeds=[(r,c,inp[r][c]) for r in range(H) for c in range(W)
           if not(r0<=r<=r1 and c0<=c<=c1) and inp[r][c]!=bg]
    srows=sorted(set(p[0] for p in seeds)); scols=sorted(set(p[1] for p in seeds))
    sh=srows[-1]-srows[0]+1; sw=scols[-1]-scols[0]+1
    bh=ih//sh; bw=iw//sw
    for (r,c,v) in seeds:
        bi=(r-srows[0])*bh//sh; bj=(c-scols[0])*bw//sw
        for rr in range(bi*bh,min((bi+1)*bh,ih)):
            for cc in range(bj*bw,min((bj+1)*bw,iw)):
                out[1+rr][1+cc]=v
    return out
print('demo ok:',[solve(G[f'Demo pair {k} input'])==G[f'Demo pair {k} output'] for k in (1,2,3)])

    H,W=len(inp),len(inp[0])
    cnt=Counter(x for row in inp for x in row)
    bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    best=None
    for v in set(x for row in inp for x in row):
        if v==bg: continue
        pts=[(r,c) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if inp[r][c]==v]
        rs=[p[0] for p in pts]; cs=[p[1] for p in pts]
        r0,r1,c0,c1=min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs)
        hh=r1-r0+1; ww=c1-c0+1
        perim={(a,b) for a in range(r0,r1+1) for b in range(c0,c1+1) if a in(r0,r1) or b in(c0,c1)}
        if len(pts)==len(perim) and hh>=3 and ww>=3:
            if best is None or hh*ww>best[0]: best=(hh*ww,v,(r0,r1,c0,c1))
    _,fv,(r0,r1,c0,c1)=best
    ih,iw=r1-r0-1,c1-c0-1
    out=[[fv]*(iw+2) for _ in range(ih+2)]
    # seed: all pixels outside the frame bbox (incl 0s)
    seeds=[(r,c,inp[r][c]) for r in range(H) for c in range(W)
           if not(r0<=r<=r1 and c0<=c<=c1)]
    srows=sorted(set(p[0] for p in seeds)); scols=sorted(set(p[1] for p in seeds))
    sh=srows[-1]-srows[0]+1; sw=scols[-1]-scols[0]+1
    def splat(n,k):
        base,d=n//k,n%k
        return [base+1 if i<d else base for i in range(k)]
    bh=splat(ih,sh); bw_=splat(iw,sw)
    R=[sum(bh[:i]) for i in range(sh)]; A=[R[i]+bh[i] for i in range(sh)]
    C=[sum(bw_[:j]) for j in range(sw)]; X=[C[j]+bw_[j] for j in range(sw)]
    for (r,c,v) in sorted(seeds,key=lambda p:(p[0],p[1])):
        ri=r-srows[0]; ci=c-scols[0]
        if ri<0 or ri>=sh or ci<0 or ci>=sw: continue
        for rr in range(R[ri],A[ri]):
            for cc in range(C[ci],X[ci]):
                out[1+rr][1+cc]=v
    return out

def solve(inp):
    Hh,Ww=len(inp),len(inp[0])
    rings=find_ring(inp)
    fv,(r0,r1,c0,c1)=max(rings,key=lambda x:(x[1][1]-x[1][0],x[1][3]-x[1][2]))
    ih,iw=r1-r0-1,c1-c0-1
    out=[[fv]*(iw+2) for _ in range(ih+2)]
    seeds=[(r,c,inp[r][c]) for r in range(Hh) for c in range(Ww)
           if not(r0<=r<=r1 and c0<=c<=c1)]
    srows=sorted(set(p[0] for p in seeds)); scols=sorted(set(p[1] for p in seeds))
    sh=srows[-1]-srows[0]+1; sw=scols[-1]-scols[0]+1
    # block sizes proportional with base + remainder (ceil per row/col)

    bw=[(iw+sw-1)//sw]*sw
    R=[sum(bh[:i]) for i in range(sh)]; A=[R[i]+bh[i] for i in range(sh)]
    C=[sum(bw[:j]) for j in range(sw)]; X=[C[j]+bw_[j] for j in range(sw)]
    return out

import json
from collections import Counter

def find_rings(inp):
    Hh,Ww=len(inp),len(inp[0])
    res=[]
    for v in set(x for row in inp for x in row):
        pts=[(r,c) for r in range(Hh) for c in range(Ww) if inp[r][c]==v]
        rs=[p[0] for p in pts]; cs=[p[1] for p in pts]
        r0,r1,c0,c1=min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs)
        hh=r1-r0+1; ww=c1-c0+1
        if hh>=3 and ww>=3:
            perim={(a,b) for a in range(r0,r1+1) for b in range(c0,c1+1) if a in(r0,r1) or b in(c0,c1)}
            if len(pts)==len(perim) and all(inp[a][b]==v for a,b in perim):
                res.append((v,(r0,r1,c0,c1)))
    return res

def solve(inp):
    Hh,Ww=len(inp),len(inp[0])
    rings=find_rings(inp)
    fv,(r0,r1,c0,c1)=max(rings,key=lambda x:(x[1][1]-x[1][0],x[1][3]-x[1][2]))
    ih,iw=r1-r0-1,c1-c0-1

    scols=sorted(set(c for r in range(Hh) for c in range(Ww) if not(r0<=r<=r1 and c0<=c<=c1)))
    sh=srows[-1]-srows[0]+1; sw=scols[-1]-scols[0]+1
    assert ih%sh==0 and iw%sw==0,(ih,iw,sh,sw)
    s=ih//sh; t=iw//sw
    for r in srows:

                ri=(r-srows[0])*s; ci=(c-scols[0])*t
                for dr in range(s):

    return out
